headline: PBOC Expands e-CNY Network to Offshore Banks and Foreign Corporate Wallets
summary: The People's Bank of China is expanding its central bank digital currency network to offshore institutions, including Hong Kong branches, and enabling local e-CNY wallets for foreign firms.
why: The People's Bank of China is China's central bank, developing the e-CNY to facilitate digital transactions and strengthen cross-border payment efficiency.

impacts.name: Chinese yuan
impacts.why: Expansion of central bank digital currency network capabilities supports cross-border adoption of the yuan.
